planned.identity: One fictional squat rectangular perfume bottle of translucent smoky obsidian glass with wider shoulders and a front-left diagonal facet.
planned.wardrobe_props: Asymmetrical brushed-silver collar, low black stone cap, one internal amber droplet, one rotating silver petal ring, no label.
planned.space_direction: Bottle remains centered in shallow black liquid while camera arcs front-left toward center and ring rotates clockwise.
planned.motion: Bottle rises two centimeters; clip ends with one petal crossing the front-right edge and an exterior droplet descending on the left face.
planned.light_material: Large soft white source camera-left, narrow amber underlight, dense glass and viscous black liquid.
planned.story_beat: The sealed product emerges and accumulates an unresolved moving ring and droplet state.

grammar.narrative_moment: End before the cap opens, with petal and droplet motion visibly unresolved.
grammar.camera_movement: Macro bottle-height twenty-degree arc from front-left toward center with controlled focus on silhouette and facet.
grammar.light_color: Fixed large white source camera-left and narrow amber underlight; reflections track real surface and camera movement.
grammar.space_composition: Single centered bottle, low liquid horizon, stable negative space, front-left facet and front-right petal both readable.
grammar.material_physics: Dense glass, brushed metal, stone cap, viscous liquid, restrained displacement ripples, and gravity-driven droplet motion.
